01 — Who I amAbout

I turn raw ideas into interfaces people can touch, code that actually runs, and stories that move. One mind — design, build, create.

I'm Jehoiakim Jezer M. Luna, a second-year Bachelor of Science in Information Technology student at Bukidnon State University in Malaybalay City, Bukidnon.

My practice sits where three crafts meet: I design clean, usable interfaces in Figma, I prototype and build for the web, and I develop in Java — including games. On top of that, I create AI-assisted story videos, which taught me pacing, framing and how to hold an audience's attention.

I learn by shipping. Every skill on this page was picked up by making something real with it, breaking it, and making it better.

Featured Project — Demo Case StudyProject

Kape Culture —
Coffee Shop Launch Package

A complete demo project for a fictional coffee shop, showing exactly how I work — from brief to delivery.

01 — The Brief

A new coffee shop in Malaybalay City is opening. It needs a one-week social media launch that announces the opening, showcases its signature iced latte, runs a weekend Buy 1 Get 1 promo, and starts growing a following — all in one warm, consistent brand style (warm brown + cream).
